osStates.waiting: Waiting for an OS opportunity after interruption
osStates.finished: Automatic work ended; check the file results
osStates.exhausted: OS attempt budget exhausted; waiting for the next schedule

transfer.title: Backup Activity
transfer.description: Selected Files and Photos go directly to your paired PC over native encrypted LAN. The PC must separately approve your backup folder.
transfer.more: Showing up to 100 jobs; {{count}} remain in the durable journal.

backups.title: Your completed PC backups
backups.description: Only this phone’s completed backups on the currently paired PC are listed. Files restore to a new location you choose on your phone; existing files and Photos originals are never replaced or deleted.
backups.photosOpen: Verified Photos manifests can restore media into the phone’s Photos library. File backups still save to a new document. Existing media is not overwritten; ambiguous or unsupported imports wait for review.
backups.empty: No completed backups were returned by this PC.
backups.completed: PC backup completed · Local encrypted LAN
backups.restoring: Restore is running in the foreground. Bytes and SHA-256 are verified; Photos import receipts survive interruption. File downloads may leave an incomplete new document after restart.
backups.restored: {{name}} saved to a new file — destination bytes and SHA-256 verified.

photos.pending: {{completed}} / {{total}} Photos assets verified; remaining jobs wait for a user-triggered retry.
photos.completed: Last import verification: {{completed}} / {{total}} Photos assets and supported album metadata verified. Restoring again rechecks the target.
photos.review_required: {{review}} Photos jobs need review. A previous import may already exist or access is uncertain; no second copy is created automatically.
photos.organization_review: {{review}} The media or album relationships need review; full restoration is not assumed.

states.owner_deleted: Deleted on computer; automatic reupload suppressed

errors.pairing_required: Pair with a PC before sending files.
errors.cancelled: Operation cancelled. Incomplete work is retained; no success is assumed.
errors.manifest_invalid: The Photos manifest is incomplete, unsupported or inconsistent. Nothing is imported from it.
errors.photo_permission_lost: Full Photos access is required to verify existing assets safely. Grant access and retry; no duplicate is created.
errors.photo_review_required: Photos import needs review. A previous copy may already exist; no automatic second import is attempted.
errors.destination_unavailable: The restore destination could not be written and read back. Choose another location; no restore success is assumed.
errors.destination_permission_lost: Restore destination access was lost. Choose a new file and retry.
errors.destination_not_empty: The destination is not empty. It was not overwritten or deleted; choose a new file.
errors.restore_cleanup_failed: Restore did not complete and the newly created destination could not be removed. An incomplete file may remain; remove it yourself before retrying to a new file.
errors.os_interrupted: The operating system stopped the job. Progress is retained while waiting for an execution opportunity.
errors.automatic_pause_not_saved: The automatic pause could not be saved. Work stopped for this session; it may restart after reopening. Check storage.
errors.background_unavailable: The operating system could not start the background backup service. Keep the app open and try again.
errors.native_unsupported: The required native backup module is unavailable on this platform.
errors.source_permission_lost: Source access was lost. Select the original folder again; pending work is retained.
errors.source_changed: The source changed. The previous version will not resume with an old hash.
errors.snapshot_unavailable: The verified local snapshot is unavailable. Pending work is retained.
errors.local_storage_full: Phone storage is full. Free space and retry; pending work is retained.
errors.queue_unavailable: The local queue cannot be read or updated. No progress is assumed.
errors.paused: Sync is paused. Pending work is retained.
errors.denied: The PC denied access. Check pairing and the separate PC backup-folder approval.
errors.invalid_request: The PC rejected this request. Pending work is retained.
errors.not_found: The PC operation was not found. It will not be silently replaced.
errors.conflict: The PC operation does not match this source or offset. Automatic resume is blocked.
errors.hash_mismatch: The verified bytes did not match. Completion was not accepted.
errors.acl_busy: The PC authorization journal is busy. Retry later.
errors.acl_unavailable: PC authorization cannot be verified. File access stays closed.
errors.backup_unavailable: The PC backup folder is unavailable. Reconnect it and retry.
errors.backup_full: PC backup storage is full. Free space on the PC and retry.
errors.backup_busy: The PC backup file is locked. Close the locking application and retry.
errors.backup_permission_denied: The PC cannot access the approved backup folder. Check its permissions.
errors.backup_path_rejected: The PC rejected an unsafe backup path.
errors.backup_scope_changed: The PC backup folder changed. Reselect and explicitly approve it on the PC.
errors.connection_closed: LAN connection interrupted. The job remains queued for verified resume.
errors.lan_unavailable: The paired PC is not reachable over the approved LAN route.
errors.identity_unavailable: Native device identity is unavailable. File access stays closed.
errors.revoked: Pairing was revoked. Files will not be sent under the old pairing.
errors.outcome_unknown: The result could not be confirmed. Pending work is retained; no success is assumed.
errors.owner_deleted: This source version was deleted on the computer. It will not be automatically uploaded again.
errors.source_identity_unknown: The source identity could not be verified. The previous backup was not adopted.
errors.retry_clock_unavailable: A reliable retry interval cannot be verified. Work is retained; automatic retry stopped.
errors.storage_failure: The durable record could not be read or saved. The pause or continue result is unconfirmed; check again.
errors.automatic_unavailable: The operating system could not schedule automatic backup. Automatic execution is not confirmed; you can start a manual backup with Sync now.
errors.settings_changed: Stopped because settings changed. Completed backups and recovery records are retained. New work uses the current sources, PC and schedule settings.
errors.source_unavailable: Make the source available in Files or select it again; pending work is retained.
errors.local_permission_lost: Kloda cannot access a local file or folder on this phone. Check its Files permission.
errors.local_path_rejected: A local path or file could not be verified safely. Nothing was overwritten.
errors.interrupted: The app stopped before the result was confirmed. Progress is retained for verified resume.
errors.photos_unavailable: iOS Photos backup is not connected yet. Files results are shown separately.
errors.review_required: Photos import needs review. No automatic second copy will be created.
errors.organization_review: The media or album relationships need review; full restoration is not assumed.
errors.destination_required: Explicitly enable at least one backup destination first.
errors.webdav_auth: The WebDAV server rejected the username or password.
errors.webdav_storage: The device’s secure WebDAV profile could not be read or saved.
errors.webdav_missing: No native WebDAV profile is saved.
errors.webdav_response: The WebDAV server response did not meet the safe publication contract.
errors.webdav_test_required: Test the saved profile again first.
errors.candidate_stale: The app or action is no longer active. No new run was started.
errors.connection_unavailable: This destination could not be reached. Other destinations have independent results and attempt budgets.
errors.credential_locked: Secure credentials are currently locked. Unlock the device.
errors.user_pause: This run was paused by the user.
errors.webdav_fields: Enter a valid HTTPS endpoint, destination folder, username and password.
errors.wifi_required: WebDAV transfers require a suitable Wi-Fi or Ethernet connection.
errors.nextcloud_login: Nextcloud sign-in could not be completed. Check the server address and try again.
errors.nextcloud_server_mismatch: The server answered for a different address than the one entered. Sign-in was stopped.
errors.nextcloud_login_expired: Sign-in was not confirmed within 20 minutes. Start again.
errors.destination_limit: This device already has 8 cloud destinations. Remove one before adding another.
errors.destination_exists: This destination is already saved on this device.
errors.destination_unsupported: Backups to this destination cannot be turned on yet.

transfer.rebackupConfirm: Explicitly send this unchanged source version again to the currently paired computer? The computer must approve file access.
transfer.notificationsDisabled: Notifications are off. You may miss transfer and error notifications; check backup status on this screen.
transfer.automaticPaused: Automatic backup is paused. It will stay paused until you explicitly continue.
transfer.pauseExplanation: Pause stops the current transfer and automatic backup. Sync now starts one run only; it does not enable automatic backup.
transfer.retryAt: Next retry no earlier than {{time}} while Kloda is active.

runStates.running: Checking sources and sending selected backups.
runStates.paused: Work interrupted or paused; progress and retry budget retained.
runStates.retry_wait: Connection failed. Waiting 60 seconds before retrying.
runStates.finished: Scan finished. Check individual backup results below.
runStates.needs_attention: Scan finished with items needing attention; backup is not fully successful.

onboarding.liveDescription: Backs up at the first opportunity allowed by the operating system. Continuous operation or an exact start time is not guaranteed.
onboarding.title: Select folders to back up
onboarding.description: Select folders or Photos sources to back up, then pair your computer.
onboarding.sourceRequired: Select at least one source before continuing.
onboarding.sourceUnavailable: This source is inaccessible. Check permissions and select it again.
onboarding.storageDescription: Enter your storage address and credentials to verify the connection.
onboarding.webdavScope: Selected Files/Photos sources go to the WebDAV destination you separately enable. Schedules depend on OS execution opportunities; the PC destination uses its own native permissions.

webdavErrors.webdav_fields: Enter an HTTPS endpoint, folder, username and password. Endpoint credentials, query/fragment and dot paths are not accepted.
webdavErrors.webdav_connection: The WebDAV connection or supplied credentials could not be verified.
webdavErrors.webdav_probe_incomplete: The probe could not be completed or cleaned up. Temporary Kloda test data may remain; no success was saved.
webdavErrors.webdav_cancelled_probe: The test was cancelled after it started writing. Temporary Kloda test data may remain.
webdavErrors.webdav_storage: The secure settings could not be read or confirmed saved. Test status is not confirmed.
webdavErrors.webdav_busy: Another connection test is already running.

onboarding.storageTested: Saved settings passed a previous connection test. This is not a current reachability guarantee.
onboarding.testError: WebDAV connection could not be verified.
onboarding.invalidTime: Use HH:mm for the local start time.
onboarding.runtimeUnavailable: Kloda native runtime is unavailable. Rebuild the development app.
onboarding.saveError: Preferences could not be saved. Try again.

pairing.title: Pair your phone
pairing.description: Scan the Kloda invitation on your computer. Both devices must be on the same local network.
pairing.scanDescription: Point the rear camera at the computer's Kloda QR code. No manual secret entry is available.
pairing.cameraPermission: Camera access is used only to scan this pairing invitation.
pairing.cameraDenied: Camera permission is denied. Allow access to scan; pairing cannot proceed without a QR scan.
pairing.cameraError: Camera permission could not be checked or requested.
pairing.cameraUnavailable: The rear camera could not be opened. It may be unavailable or in use by another app.
pairing.cameraPaused: The camera is paused while Kloda is in the background.
pairing.noFileGrant: Pairing establishes device trust only. It does not grant access to files, folders or photos.
pairing.cancelConsequences: Cancellation affects this phone's attempt or local binding only. The computer may retain a committed record; this is not distributed rollback.
pairing.unknownDescription: An interrupted operation is not proof of success or rollback. Read native status, or explicitly resume or cancel a saved attempt.
pairing.leaveConsequences: Leaving closes this view and its connection. It does not complete pairing or delete saved pending or pinned records.
pairing.repairDescription: This computer's previous local trust was revoked. Check the authenticated computer fingerprint before explicitly pairing again.
pairing.repairConsequences: The old revoked record and all file-access denies remain unchanged. A new attempt still requires approval on the computer.
pairing.helpComputer: Open the phone-pairing invitation in Kloda on your computer. After scanning, approve the exact phone candidate there.
pairing.helpLan: Keep both devices on the same local network. Pairing does not use a remote relay or accept a manually entered secret.
pairing.helpRecovery: A saved pending record is not a completed pairing. Resume retries the same native-owned identity binding; cancellation does not delete the computer's record.

unpair.title: Remove pairing with this computer?
unpair.description: When reachable, the PC must confirm durable revocation first. Phone-only removal does not revoke the PC’s permissions. Backed-up photos are not deleted.
unpair.pc_confirmed: The PC durably revoked device trust and file permissions. Pairing was removed on this phone; backed-up photos were preserved.
unpair.local_only: Pairing was removed only on this phone. PC revocation was not confirmed; its old permissions may remain. A new QR pairing is required to reconnect.
unpair.pc_unconfirmed: The PC did not confirm durable revocation. Pairing has not been removed on this phone. Retry, or explicitly remove only on this phone.

idle.title: Ready to scan
idle.description: Create a fresh invitation on the computer, then scan its QR code.

open.title: Invitation open
open.description: The invitation is active, but no device trust has been established.

connecting.title: Connecting securely
connecting.description: Native Kloda is checking the computer and local connection. No durable pending record or trust pin is confirmed yet.

reserved.title: Waiting for computer approval
reserved.description: The computer has reserved a candidate. Only an explicit decision on the computer can approve normal pairing.

pending.title: Pairing pending
pending.description: This phone saved a pending binding. The computer's commitment has not yet been confirmed. Check the candidate on your computer.

consumed_pending_ack.title: Pinned; completion pending
consumed_pending_ack.description: The computer's identity is durably pinned on this phone. The completion exchange is not confirmed; resume can recover the same pair.

complete.title: Pairing complete
complete.description: This phone saved the computer's trust pin and received the completion exchange. File access still requires separate authorization.

invalid.title: Attempt ended
invalid.description: This invitation is no longer active. A computer-side record may remain; do not assume rollback.

revoked.title: Disabled on this phone
revoked.description: The local attempt or binding is disabled. Any computer-side trust and file-access denies remain separate.

errors.invalid_qr: This is not a valid Kloda pairing QR.
errors.unsupported_version: This QR uses an unsupported pairing version.
errors.lan_unavailable: A permitted local-network route is unavailable.
errors.native_unsupported: Secure native pairing is unavailable in this app build. Use a supported Kloda native build; no pairing has been simulated.
errors.identity_unavailable: Kloda's hardware-protected device identity is unavailable.
errors.continuity_lost: The saved local identity or installation continuity cannot be verified. Automatic trust recovery is blocked.
errors.tls_rejected: The computer's authenticated TLS identity was rejected.
errors.proof_rejected: The pairing proof was rejected by native Kloda.
errors.invitation_expired: The invitation expired. Create a fresh QR on the computer.
errors.candidate_stale: This exact candidate is no longer current. Read native status before making another decision.
errors.already_paired: This computer already has an active local pairing.
errors.storage_failure: The required durable pairing record could not be written or read. Completion is not confirmed.
errors.connection_closed: The connection closed. Any saved pending or pinned record remains subject to native status and explicit recovery.
errors.outcome_unknown: The pairing outcome cannot be determined. Do not assume completion or rollback.
errors.cancelled: The local operation was cancelled. This does not promise deletion of the computer's record.
errors.revoked: The local pairing is revoked and cannot be resumed.

computer.title: Back up to your computer
computer.description: Send selected files and photos to your own computer over your local network.
computer.pairDescription: Open Kloda on your computer and scan its pairing QR with this phone.
computer.grantTitle: 2. Approve the backup folder on the computer
computer.grantDescription: In Devices and permissions on the computer, select this phone. Choose a separate backup folder and explicitly approve file access. This permission cannot be granted from the phone.
computer.availability: Pairing does not confirm that the computer is currently reachable or its receiver is ready. Keep the computer awake with Kloda running. Backup Activity shows current access and transfer results.
computer.iosBackground: iOS may run authorized backups when it provides an execution opportunity. Locked protected data may defer work. New pairing, approvals and restore require the app in the foreground.
computer.iosSchedulePreference: iOS chooses when automatic work can run; exact timing or continuous execution is not guaranteed. Pause stops automatic backups until Continue is selected.
computer.androidBackground: Authorized backups continue when you leave this screen while Android permits. New pairing, approvals and restore require the app in the foreground. If the system stops the work, reopen the app to continue.
computer.foregroundOnly: Keep the app in the foreground for pairing, approval and restore. Native transfer and background integration are not complete on this platform yet.
computer.inactive: Bring Kloda to the foreground to read current status.
computer.androidSchedulePreference: Android runs automatic work when the OS allows; exact timing or continuous execution is not guaranteed. Pause also stops automatic backups until Continue is selected.
computer.schedulePreference: The schedule preference is saved; automatic execution is not enabled on this platform yet.

setup.m1Body: Kloda backs up your files and photos to your own computer or the storage you choose. No central account required.
m1Points: You pick source folders and albums
You pair with your computer via QR
You grant the backup folder separately on the computer

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.noPhotoPermission: Photo permission not granted — personal media is not read.

ui.pcInspect: View device trust or pair with QR. File access is approved separately on the computer.
ui.savedTarget: Saved destination; a previous test does not prove current access.
ui.noSavedCloud: Add a destination or review saved WebDAV settings. Computer status is shown separately.
ui.integrationUnavailableBody: This connection option cannot transfer files yet. No credentials are saved and no successful connection is claimed.
ui.authNotConfigured: Account connection is not enabled yet.
ui.fontUnavailable: The font could not load; the system font is being used.

gallery.readOnly: Selected Photos sources · Read only · Previews are kept in app memory; no automatic cloud download.
gallery.error: Photos could not be read safely. Refresh or review source permissions.
gallery.limited: Limited photo access: only permitted items appear. Backup still requires full Photos access.
gallery.empty: No accessible photos or videos in this source.
gallery.previewUnavailable: Preview unavailable locally. No original is downloaded automatically.
gallery.videoPoster: Video poster only; playback is not included.
gallery.historyNote: Up to 16 recent local transfer records, newest first. These are past receipts, not a fresh PC or current-photo integrity check. Media receipts alone do not prove metadata backup. Records can refer to earlier versions or reused source locators.
gallery.noHistory: No local transfer record found. Backup status is unknown.
gallery.scopeUnavailable: The OS cannot expose membership of the selected album with limited access. Review album access or use a separately selected library source. Gallery access has not been broadened.

destinations.optInHint: Saving or testing the connection does not start backups. Enable the saved profile separately. Each destination has independent results and retries.

states.finished: This run was verified and completed

destinations.pcOptInHint: Pairing alone does not select a destination. Enable this PC separately; its backup folder must also be approved on the PC.

review.title: Pending WebDAV publications
review.hint: When the result is unknown, equal bytes alone do not prove ownership. Keep both publishes a known uploaded temporary file under a new name and preserves the existing file.
review.stale: The list could not be verified; actions are paused.
review.empty: No pending publications in the local journal.
review.oldContext: This work’s context is no longer active. Its data and history are retained without automatic rebinding.

results.completed: This publication was verified. Use Sync Now to check all current sources.
results.skipped: Skipped work is not completed. Bytes and work history are retained.

review.authorizeKeepBoth: Authorize this work and keep both
review.authorizationHint: This action authorizes only this work under current settings. The same selected source is verified again; original records and unknown results are retained.

restore.title: My WebDAV backups
restore.hint: Only this device’s completed receipts are listed. Restore verifies remote bytes again and preserves existing files in the folder you choose.
restore.unavailable: Native restore for this content is not yet connected.

smb.scope: SMB3 on your local network, with encryption and signing. Enter a numeric LAN IP; server names and Internet fallback are unavailable.
smb.enableHint: Save and enable explicitly selects this destination for backups of your selected Files and Photos. Saving is not proof of a successful connection or backup.
smb.reviewHint: Unknown results stay in review. Keep both reads the selected file again and publishes a separate copy; it preserves earlier evidence and existing remote content.
smb.restoreHint: Only this device’s Completed receipts are listed. Restore verifies remote bytes again before publishing to your selected folder or photo library.

errors.smb_fields: Enter a valid numeric LAN IP, port, share, folder and account. A password is required.
errors.lan_unavailable: A permitted local-network route is unavailable.
errors.integration_unavailable: Native SMB is unavailable in this app build or OS version.

errors.native_3: The server response is unavailable or uncertain. Review this work before making another copy.

errors.native_7: Remote bytes could not be verified.

sftp.reviewHint: Unknown results stay in review. Keep both reads the selected file again and publishes a separate copy; it preserves earlier evidence and existing remote content.
sftp.restoreHint: Only this device’s Completed receipts are listed. Restore verifies remote bytes again before publishing to your selected folder or photo library.

ftps.restoreHint: Only this device’s verified transfer receipts are listed. Restore verifies the content again before writing to your selected folder or photo library.

s3.scope: Amazon S3 and S3-compatible destinations have separate configurations.
s3.custody: Secret fields stay in the device secure store; saved values are never returned to this screen.
s3.saveHint: Saving does not verify the connection or enable backup. Use an existing bucket and a separate test prefix.

errors.s3_fields: Check the destination and credential fields.
errors.invalid_request: Check the destination and credential fields.
errors.native_unavailable: S3 is not available in this build.
errors.storage_failure: Could not read or write the secure configuration.
errors.credential_locked: Unlock the device and try again.
errors.context_changed: The configuration changed. Reopen this screen.
errors.candidate_stale: Bring the app to the foreground and try again.
errors.s3_auth: Check the access key, secret, session token and bucket permissions.
errors.target_missing: Check the bucket, region and destination configuration.
errors.conflict: The object already exists; it was not overwritten.
errors.multipart_restart_required: The multipart upload conflicted; this job will not be sent again automatically.
errors.review_required: The result is uncertain; the job remains in review.
errors.verification_failed: Readback bytes could not be verified; the job was not marked complete.
errors.profile_missing: Save the secure destination configuration first.

s3.testHint: Uploads a small app-generated file to the saved destination and verifies it by reading it back. Does not use selected files/photos or enable backups. The test object remains at the destination; provider usage charges may apply. Save a separate test prefix first.
s3.testSuccess: Test file uploaded and verified by reading it back. Backups remain off.

security.aws: V1 transfers use HTTPS; Amazon S3 encrypts data on the server with AWS-managed keys. Kloda does not add client-side encryption. AWS and authorized account access can read the content.
security.compatible: Transfers use HTTPS. Server-side encryption depends on the provider settings; Kloda does not add client-side encryption. Personal backups require provider verification.

s3.manualHint: Explicitly enable backup of selected Files and Photos to this AWS destination. Run starts the transfer. Automatic work can be enabled separately.
s3.catalogHint: Only this device’s verified completion receipts for this destination are listed. Restore verifies the cloud file again and writes to the folder you select.
s3.reviewHint: Jobs with unknown responses are never automatically completed or replayed. Existing files and records are retained.
s3.automaticHint: Automatic work backs up selected sources using the current schedule settings. Delivery depends on the OS, network and lock state; uncertain jobs are never automatically replayed.
s3.copied: New separate copy verified: {{name}}. The original uncertain record is retained.

statusUi.title: Status
statusUi.explicitTarget: Backups go only to destinations you explicitly enable.
statusUi.activityLine: Review current work and previous results.

lines.setup: Choose sources and explicitly enable a backup destination.
lines.syncing: Progress reflects acknowledgements received by the device.
lines.safe: Showing the last run confirmed by the device.
lines.waiting: See Activity for schedule, permission and connection details.
lines.error: See Activity for the cause and safe retry options.
